The hall clock can be set from outside, through a hatch, with a rod.
The lime tree outside the library is the oldest thing on the street.
Market day on Lantern Row is Friday.

The street is cobbled at the top and tarmac below the hall.
The plane trees at the top of the street are cut back every winter.
The Baker house is 10 minutes' drive up the hill road.
